content.html:
Fibonacci sequence

The Fibonacci sequence is defined through the recurrence relation $F_n = F_(n-1) + F_(n-2)$. It can also be expressed in closed form:

$ F_n = round(1 / sqrt(5) phi.alt^n), quad phi.alt = (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2 $

if n <= 2 { 1 } else { fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2) } )

The first #count numbers of the sequence are:

#align(center, table( columns: count, ..nums.map(n => $F_#n$), ..nums.map(n => str(fib(n))), ))
